Naomi / Marissa —

Attached is my first-pass redline for the MSA (high level only). Key items I pulled out for Sales:

- Indemnity: Counterparty has broad indemnity; will propose mutual indemnity with carveouts for third-party data breaches not caused by Redwood.
- Data residency & export: Their draft wants unrestricted transfer. We should preserve US/EU residency commitments for pilot and propose narrow data transfer mechanisms.
- SLA / credits: Their SLA is a 99.9% uptime request with aggressive credits. Suggest we keep SLA language but cap credits (standard Redwood caps) and condition credits on timely incident reporting.
- Audit & security: Their audit clause is broad (on-demand audits). Propose security questionnaire + SOC2 + remote evidence first; on-site audit by exception.
- Limitation of liability: Their limitation is unlimited for certain causes — propose Redwood standard cap (2x fees up to $1M for pilot).

I flagged these in the attached redline document and added comment bubbles where we need product/infra input.

Attachments: [kim_redlines_MSA_v1.docx]

Next steps I recommend:
1) Sales confirm entity/billing details and residency.
2) We provide a short summary memo to the customer before the negotiation call to set expectations.
3) Book a 30-min negotiation call for 11/05 or 11/08.

--Kimberly
